value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate, it depends on the lender and whether the mortgage is insured (under 20% down). The lowest insured rate I found is 4.34%, from Ratehub and Wowa. The cheapest Big 6 bank is about 4.54%, and Scotiabank is 4.74%. The uninsured numbers I found don't agree with each other, so I can't confirm a lowest figure for those. I also didn't find a Toronto or Ontario-specific rate, so these are national numbers. Fixed rates have been going up since early September.
